data.description:
Discovered while fixing [rebar:dbb2-e329-994d-4c8f]. Not a defect — a cleanup that removes
now-dead duplication.

`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` shadows the engine `rebar_reconciler` package whenever pytest
collects anything under `tests/unit/` (prepend import mode puts `tests/unit` at `sys.path[0]`).
The workaround — appending the engine package dir to the shadow's `__path__` — had been written
out THREE times, each independently:

* `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py` (`_seed_dotted_namespace`, the original, f32b19b1e7)
* `tests/unit/test_canonical_consolidation.py:66-67` (inline, comment: "like
  `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py`")
* `tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py:118-119` (inline, comment: "the pattern the reconciler
  conftest uses")

The two inline copies are exactly the fingerprint of the dbb2 defect: both live in TOP-LEVEL
`tests/unit` modules, i.e. two prior authors hit the same shadow from outside
`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` and patched locally instead of hoisting the compensation.

dbb2's fix hoists it to `tests/unit/conftest.py`, which now runs for every `tests/unit`
collection. All three older copies are therefore redundant. They are harmless (each checks
membership before appending, so they no-op), which is why dbb2 deliberately left them alone
rather than widening its diff.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The two inline copies are removed, and each call site relies on the `tests/unit/conftest.py`
      bridge instead
- [ ] Decide and record whether the `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py` copy stays: it is
      arguably still worth keeping as local documentation at the site of the shadow, but it is no
      longer load-bearing
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_canonical_consolidation.py tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py`
      passes both alone and in a mixed selection with `tests/scripts/reducer`
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` still passes (2288 tests)
- [ ] The dbb2 guard
      (`tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py::test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active`)
      still passes
data.title: Drop the now-redundant inline rebar_reconciler __path__ workarounds
